svg.text: A188 -- the S01 basin (the 'room at side 4' family) is a LINE: 4 unit chords on one axis-parallel line lock the side at 4.000 > s0 = 3.877084 -- per class frame, with the alive S01/S03 pages

Source: attempts/A188-s01-basin/results/{s01_basin.jsonl, consumer188.jsonl}, docs/proofs/local_certificate_s01.md; drawing rules of docs/residue_map/gen_a57_lp.py (every drawn square checked for containment and disjointness).
k5_11 frame -- S01, the room family, drawn as a packing at its own side s* = 4.000 (4x4 grid completion of the pins)
checked: worst pairwise SAT gap +0.0000, all inside the s* container: True | s* - s0 = +0.1229 (13x the pinwheel's slack)
BANNER: s* > s0 -- this configuration is NOT a packing at s0; the s0 container (black) is overlaid on the s* container (grey)
y-band k=3: 1 free square(s) within 0.207 of y in [0.27, 0.99]
y-band k=1: 3 free square(s) within 0.207 of y in [1.01, 1.99]
y-band k=1: 3 free square(s) within 0.207 of y in [2.89, 3.67]
x-band k=3: 1 free within 0.207 of x in [0.27, 0.99]
x-band k=1: 3 free within 0.207 of x in [1.01, 1.99]
x-band k=1: 3 free within 0.207 of x in [2.89, 3.67]
WHAT THIS IS: the S01 basin in the k5_11 frame = every dashed band in which (4 - k) non-pin squares,
at ANY position along the line and ANY tilt, join the k pins of that line: side >= 4 > s0 (Theorem S01-LINE).
Pages: the conditioned boxes of the frame's alive S01/S03 pages -- green = inside a certified band (1: the YES
leaf is dead, the NO children owe 3 - k boxes), orange = outside (3; the growth factor x is printed).
Blue = the frame's pins in their delta-cores; yellow = the other squares of the side-4 packing; purple bands =
the k = 3 lines (A144's node-level guard-line kill: one more square with chord > 0.877 on the line).
